## 4.2.7 (HexGhoul): Eto, Touka and Ken: more to talk about, and more ways to win or lose them

HexKagune 4.2.7 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol unchanged (129).

You said (quoted exactly): "So add as much text as you can to every single NPC, just some that can increase relationship, um, some that
reduce it."

**Eto** has 11 new topics (25 in all): her favourite book, fan mail, why her stories end badly, her editor, the bandages, what Aogiri is to
her, whether she gets lonely (at night), and whether she's the owl the ghouls whisper about (asked once, and threatening to tell the doves is
a very bad idea). Once you're together: what she likes about you, when she knew, and promises.

**Touka** has 11 new topics (21 in all): her exams, latte art (it's a rabbit lying down), the café's regulars, Ayato, being hungry on shift,
learning to kick, her rabbit mask, and whether rabbits really die of loneliness (asked once). Once you're together: when she started liking
you, "you're cute when you're angry", and promises.

**Ken** has 10 new topics (19 in all): his favourite author, the eyepatch, his white hair (told once), his mask, working at Anteiku, whether it
still hurts, why he's so polite, and not sleeping without a light on (at night). Once you're together: when he knew, and promises.

As before: every topic has answers that win them and answers that cost (tell Touka to just eat a customer, or Ken to get over it), kind
answers count once a day each and unkind ones always count, and the things said once stay said.
